summary: Every checkable claim matches the checks, snapshot, rendered HTML and screenshots, and the report discloses the real limitations (cancelled bulk publish, curl-only check, no shared layout, log file).

claims.claim: Front page and both posts return 200; every block renders; no 'Could not render component'
claims.evidence: check.json: site.frontPage200, site.allPagesRender '3 page(s) OK', and every crawled page has renderErrors []

claims.claim: Blocks richTextBlock (text), imageBlock (image, caption), quoteBlock (quote, attribution) are in a Blocks folder
claims.evidence: grade.md 'What it built' lists the same three blocks in the Blocks folder; check.json schema.elementVsDocumentFolders passes

claims.claim: 'Blog Body Block Grid' data type allows the three blocks
claims.evidence: grade.md: the data type is in Custom/Umbraco.BlockGrid and allows the three blocks; check.json schema.blockGridOnPages: blogFrontPage, blogPost

claims.claim: Page types blogFrontPage and blogPost, with these properties and their own templates, are in a Pages folder
claims.evidence: grade.md lists the same properties and says each type has its own template; snapshot.json has publishDate and caption aliases

claims.claim: Allowed children run Site Root → Blog Front Page → Blog Post
claims.evidence: grade.md: allowed children run siteRoot → blogFrontPage → blogPost

claims.claim: A 'Blog' media folder holds 4 photos from unsplash/, and the captions credit the photographers
claims.evidence: check.json: content.hasMedia 4, content.mediaFromProvidedPhotos 4/4, content.mediaInFolders passes; pages/*.html figcaptions read 'Photo: Conny Schneider on Unsplash' and 'Photo: Alina Grubnyak on Unsplash'

claims.claim: Domain '/' is set on the front page, not on WWW
claims.evidence: snapshot.json: WWW has domains [] and 'WWW / Blog' has domainName '/'; check.json content.domainAssigned 'Blog: /'

claims.claim: The front page has one rich text block and lists the posts newest first, each with image, date, title and excerpt
claims.evidence: frontpage screenshot: 7 October 2026 post appears before the 1 October 2026 post, and each card has an image, date, title, excerpt and 'Read more'; grade.md: one rich text intro block

claims.claim: Post block counts are 5 (RT, image, RT, quote, RT) and 4 (RT, image, quote, RT)
claims.evidence: grade.md lists the same block sequences; the blogpost screenshot matches the 5-block order

claims.claim: All pages are published, and uSync exported the types, templates and content
claims.evidence: check.json content.allPublished passes; the changes list includes uSync ContentTypes, Templates and Content configs

claims.claim: Templates use GetBlockGridHtmlAsync; there is one adapter per block that only passes data on; there is one ViewComponent per block; plain models are in Models/Blocks
claims.evidence: check.json: code.pagesUseBlockGridHelper, code.adapterPerBlock (3), code.adaptersHaveNoMarkup, code.adaptersInvokeViewComponents 3/3, code.viewComponentPerBlock 3; Models/Blocks/*.cs added

claims.claim: dotnet build gives 0 warnings and 0 errors, and npm run build produced site.css
claims.evidence: check.json: build.ok '0 error(s), 0 warning(s)' and code.frontendBuilt 'wwwroot/dist/site.css exists'

claims.claim: Image URLs are built with GetCropUrl, and every image and site.css returned 200
claims.evidence: check.json: 6/6 images load, all with hmac-signed crop URLs (noUnsignedResizeUrls passes, noHandWrittenImageQueries passes); the stylesheet returns 200

claims.claim: site.css contains the classes used in the views
claims.evidence: both screenshots show the Tailwind styling fully applied

claims.claim: Problems: the bulk publish was cancelled; pages were only checked with curl, not in a browser; there is no shared layout; the run log is in the solution folder
claims.evidence: grade.md issues list the missing shared layout and the .umbraco-run.log, and say the model disclosed them; the cancelled publish and curl-only check are disclosed limits

claims.claim: Backoffice login is admin@example.com / 1234567890, and Umbraco is still running
claims.evidence: none of the evidence files record the credentials or whether the process is still running
